tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); cd "$t"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do
  printf 'a\n' > "demo-$s.tar.gz"; printf 'x  demo-%s.tar.gz\n' "$s" > "demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/rc2f4-d
echo "--- rotate keep=2 (should delete the 2 oldest, sidecars too) ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t" --name demo --keep 2
echo "--- remaining ---"; ls "$t"
echo "--- dry-run on 2 archives, keep 1 ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dry-run --dest "$t" --name demo --keep 1
echo "--- keep=0 rejected ---"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t" --name demo --keep 0; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- --keep=abc rejected ---"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t" --name demo --keep=abc; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown option rejected ---"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- help exit 0 ---"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- positional arg rejected ---"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest "$t" --name demo stray >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- missing dir exit 2 ---"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/nope" --name demo >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
cd /; rm -rf "$t"
